sources.snippet: Dose Calculation # Dose calculation in pyRadPlan produces a dose influence matrix (dij) that encodes the dose deposited in every voxel by every beamlet. The influence matrix is the central data structure for optimization: the dose for any fluence vector w is simply the matrix-vector product dij · w.
